about.heroAlt: The Lucine collection of thoughtfully chosen accessories
about.heroTitle: We believe in the feeling of finding your thing.
about.heroText: Not more, just more meaningful. Pieces chosen to become part of your story.
about.storyP1: Lucine began with a simple thought: the things we keep closest should feel considered. The soft scarf reached for on a busy morning. The bag that carries a little of everything. The small piece of jewellery that somehow feels like you.
about.storyP2: We bring together thoughtful essentials and distinctive finds, chosen for their character, quality, and the way they make everyday moments feel a little more your own.
about.valuesText: A point of view shaped by care, curiosity, and an appreciation for the details.
about.principle1Text: Every piece earns its place through considered design, beautiful materials, and details worth noticing.
about.principle2Text: We look beyond passing trends for pieces that feel personal today and still feel right years from now.
about.principle3Text: A favourite should not wait for a special occasion. The little details can make an ordinary day feel special.
about.quote: “The best pieces don’t ask for attention. They just feel like they belong.”
about.visitImageAlt: A detail from the Lucine collection
about.visitTitle: Make it part of your everyday.
about.visitText: Take a look around, follow what catches your eye, and find the pieces that feel unmistakably yours.

faq.a1: Standard delivery arrives in 3–5 business days, and express delivery in 1–2. Orders over $100 ship free.
faq.q2: Can I return or exchange an item?
faq.a2: Yes — you have 30 days to return or exchange anything unworn, in its original packaging.
faq.q3: How do I find my size?
faq.a3: Each product page lists its measurements. If you're between sizes, our team is happy to advise in a chat.
faq.a4: We ship to most countries. Duties and delivery times are confirmed at checkout.
